outputs.name: room
outputs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw ONLY the specified target image into a VERY SIMPLE original public-preparedness handbook spot illustration. Keep its educational action readable, but remove about 75% of the rendering detail. Broad Tokyo-disaster-handbook clarity, no reproduction of any book, artist, reference character, logo or page. The user wants restrained COLOR, NOT colorful: only low-saturation dusty blue and soft sage green fills, charcoal outlines, warm pale skin and a tiny muted ochre accent when necessary. The majority of clothing and furniture may stay white. No coral, bright multicolor palette, rainbow arrangement, sepia or vivid yellow. At least 70% of the image is PURE WHITE negative space. Simple flat spot colors with NO gradient, shadow, watercolor, pencil shading, paper grain, glow or lighting. Dark charcoal fineliner contours with MICROSCOPIC hand-drawn wobble, a few tiny natural gaps at joins, slight line-weight variation and mild asymmetry. Keep contours clean and crisp; no scratchy scribble, double outlines, grunge or actual blur. Human bodies reduced to a handful of clear shapes: one solid hair silhouette, tiny dot eyes, small mouth, almost no nose, no eyelashes, blush, hair strands, clothing folds, button details or hand rendering. People must still have readable age and a tiny human expression, not empty round-headed stick-figure signs. Natural simplified hands, correct limbs. White background extends to all edges. No lettering, captions, watermarks, badges or decorative sparkles. Landscape 3:2, one scene. Remove all unnecessary room decoration and use almost orthographic diagram-like perspective. Target: FIRST of the five attached images, the bedroom home illustration. The later images are other scenes and must not be combined. Keep ONLY the parent and child looking at the room, a low shelf with THREE simple book blocks and ONE tiny toy silhouette, a small desk edge, and a plain doorway outline. Remove window, curtains, bed, rug, plant, floorboards, scenery, elaborate toys and notebook rings. Parent wears pale sage top and white trousers, child dusty-blue top and pale grey trousers. Smaller isolated room vignette, much more white space than original, almost no background. White or pale neutral furniture. The adult/child gesture should remain a simple invitation to notice the room.
